postings.title: Engines Program & Commercial Officer
postings.description:
Engines Program & Commercial Officer
Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and
customer-focused Engines Program & Commercial Officer to join our
team. This role is responsible for managing all contractual, commercial, and OEM
customer relationship aspects related to assigned and new engine programs. The
ideal candidate will act as the key interface between the company and the
customer, ensuring contractual compliance, program performance, and customer
satisfaction throughout the lifecycle of the program.
Key Responsibilities
- Act as the primary point of contact
for foreign customers for all contractual and commercial matters
related to assigned and new engines programs.
- Support the direct manager in the preparation
of cost estimates, quotations, and commercial offers for engine
production, maintenance and overhaul activities within the assigned scope
and capture of new engines opportunities business.
- Contribute to the negotiation, drafting
and management of contracts, ensuring alignment with company policies and
customer requirements.
- Manage relationship with customer throughout
the lifecycle of the contract, providing continuous customer support
during contract execution, ensuring timely and accurate communication, managing
and maintain strong customer relationships, ensuring trust,
transparency, and long-term collaboration.
- Coordinate internal departments
(Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance) in accordance to the
business plans for the contract to ensure proper execution of
contractual obligations.
- Monitor program progress and proactively
manage deviations, schedule changes, and performance issues proposing
and managing proper implementation of all the required actions to
guarantee the profitability of the assigned contract.
- Propose and implement corrective action
plans or mitigation action aimed at optimizing the management and
performance of assigned and new programs and contracts
Qualifications &
Experience
- Bachelor or Master’s degree in
Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Previous experience in sales, program
management, or contract management, preferably in aerospace, aviation, or
industrial environments.
- Familiarity with maintenance, repair, and
overhaul (MRO) or production processes is a plus.
- Solid understanding of contractual
frameworks and commercial practices.
- Experience working in cross-functional
and international environments.
Key Skills &
Competencies
- Strong communication and interpersonal
skills
- Customer-focused mindset with excellent
relationship management capabilities
- Good negotiation and problem-solving
skills
- Ability to manage complex situations and
competing priorities
- Analytical mindset with attention to
detail
- Proactive, results-driven, and
team-oriented
What We Offer
- A challenging position within a dynamic
and international environment
- Opportunities for professional and
personal development
- Exposure to strategic programs and key
customer relationships
- Contract type: Permanent employment contract (full time) - Level B2 CCNL Metalmeccanico
- Gross Annual Salary: ranging from €35,000 to 45,000 depending on experience and skills.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Program
Manager to join our Aircraft Programs team. In this role, you will be
responsible for leading complex aerospace programs from contract award through
final delivery, ensuring the achievement of technical, schedule, cost, quality,
and customer satisfaction objectives.
Acting as the primary interface between the company,
customers, suppliers, and strategic partners, you will coordinate
cross-functional teams, drive program execution, manage risks and
opportunities, and ensure compliance with contractual commitments throughout
the entire program lifecycle.
We are looking for a motivated undergraduate or recent graduate to join our Production Planning team as a Production Planner Intern, supporting the coordination and optimization of manufacturing activities within a highly regulated aerospace environment.
The selected candidate will work closely with Planning, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality teams, contributing to production planning activities, materials management, and performance monitoring, while gaining hands-on experience in aerospace manufacturing operations and planning processes.
We are looking for a motivated undergraduate or recent graduate to join our Production team as a Production Loader / Production Scheduler Intern, supporting the execution and monitoring of manufacturing activities within a highly regulated aerospace environment.
The selected candidate will work closely with Planning, Manufacturing and Quality teams, contributing to production scheduling, order release and shop-floor coordination activities, while gaining hands-on experience in aerospace manufacturing processes and compliance requirements.
